# Tender Response -- Dnro 58/02.08.01/2026

Visakoivu Oy is pleased to respond to Vuorikylan kunta's invitation to tender for the electrical and HVAC maintenance framework agreement.

Visakoivu holds the necessary electrical contracting rights for this scope of work, and our reference project portfolio includes public-sector maintenance work well above the value threshold set out in the invitation.

## Technical approach

Our quality control and testing procedures follow documented inspection and function-test protocols at each stage of the work, with records retained for the client. During the course of the work, environmental management arrangements include waste segregation on site and controlled handling of refrigerants and other regulated materials.

Our proposed HVAC maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection, filter and component replacement, and performance monitoring of building automation systems, backed by an in-house cybersecurity and OT-security auditing capability for the automation and control systems we maintain.

## Commercial terms

Price indexation is proposed on an annual basis linked to the relevant cost index, to be agreed with the contracting authority.

## Submission

Price is quoted in EUR/m2/year as required. We do not anticipate the need for subcontractors on this contract.

## Annex A

The proposed maintenance visit schedule covers all listed properties on a rolling basis throughout the year. A description of Visakoivu's environmental management system is attached.

Visakoivu looks forward to the opportunity to support Vuorikylan kunta's properties under this framework agreement.
